attributes.title: 2027 AANN Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AANN Annual Conference takes place March 13 to 16, 2027, at The Westin Seattle. Pre-conference sessions are on March 13 and the main program starts March 14. It is an in-person meeting, with recorded sessions available afterwards.

AANN says attendees can earn up to 15 CE contact hours, including pharmacology hours. AANN lists registration as opening in November 2026 and has published the rates: members pay $590 before February 24, 2027, and $690 after; nonmembers $820 and $920; students $300 and $400. Daily member registration is $315 or $415, and the Saturday pre-conference sessions cost $75 to $200 extra. Groups of five or more from one facility get 10% off the member rate.
